mapper.sql: SELECT d.dept_id, d.parent_id, d.ancestors, d.dept_name, d.order_num, d.leader, d.phone, d.email, d.status, d.del_flag, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.update_by, d.update_time FROM sys_dept d
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_dept d WHERE d.status = '0' AND d.del_flag = '0' AND d.parent_id = #{deptId}
